name: Strax, Sontaran Nurse
oracle_text:
Vigilance, trample
Grenades! — {2}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Choose a player at random. When you do, Strax fights another target creature that player controls.
Glory of Battle — Whenever Strax deals damage to a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Strax.
blocked_sentences: Grenades! — {2}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Choose a player at random. When you do, Strax fights another target creature that player controls.

needs.what: a `random: true` option on `choose_player` that picks one player uniformly at random from the pool (all players, the controller included) with no decision asked, binding the result under `as` so a following `reflexive_trigger`'s target selector can read `controller: {"binding": ...}` ("another target creature that player controls")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_player` takes only `as`, `players` and `prompt` and always asks the controller via `ask_player`; `random` exists only as a selector key over objects and on `choose_mode`/`discard`, not for picking a player, so the random seat cannot be produced and choosing it would let the controller pick the most favourable player
